abstract: Urine samples obtained from normal pregnant women and patients with trophoblastic diseases contain 30-kDa protein that suppresses phytohemagglutinin-induced T cell proliferation. The immunosuppressive protein was measured by a newly developed radioimmunoassay. The 30-kDa protein was demonstrated in almost all urine samples examined, fluid from hydatid vesicles and chorionic extracts, but not in any serum samples except at low levels in some sera from patients with choriocarcinoma. During pregnancy, the level of urinary 30-kDa protein was higher in the first (1625.5 +/- 1212.0 ng/ml, mean +/- S.D.) and second (1457.4 +/- 1332.4 ng/ml) trimesters than in the third trimester (460.6 +/- 419.0 ng/ml). The urinary 30-kDa protein/hCG ratios in patients with choriocarcinoma (8.3 +/- 10.9) were significantly higher than those in patients with hydatidiform mole (0.67 +/- 1.00, P < 0.01) and in all trimesters than those of normal pregnant women (0.54 +/- 0.44 in first trimester, P < 0.05; 0.63 +/- 0.46 in the second trimester, P < 0.05; 0.24 +/- 0.17 in the third trimester, P < 0.01). There is no significant difference between the ratios in hydatidiform mole and normal pregnancy. These findings and the fast disappearance of the 30-kDa protein from the circulation suggest that the 30-kDa protein plays a part in proliferation of trophoblastic cells in, or their invasion into the host by locally suppressing the immune reaction of the host and that the increase in the urinary 30-kDa protein level, in cases of choriocarcinoma, may be due to the malignant transformation of trophoblastic cells resulting in their rapid invasion.
abstract_ja: 正常妊婦および絨毛性疾患患者の尿には、フィトヘマグルチニン誘導性T細胞増殖を抑制する30kDa蛋白が含まれている。この免疫抑制蛋白は新たに開発したラジオイムノアッセイで測定した。30kDa蛋白はほぼすべての尿検体、水胞液および絨毛抽出液で検出されたが、血清では絨毛癌患者の一部に低レベルで検出されたのみであった。妊娠期間中、尿中30kDa蛋白レベルは第1三半期（1625.5 ± 1212.0 ng/ml, 平均 ± SD）および第2三半期（1457.4 ± 1332.4 ng/ml）で、第3三半期（460.6 ± 419.0 ng/ml）より高かった。尿中30kDa蛋白/ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)比は、絨毛癌患者（8.3 ± 10.9）で胞状奇胎患者（0.67 ± 1.00, P < 0.01）より有意に高く、また全期の正常妊婦よりも有意に高かった（第1三半期 0.54 ± 0.44, P < 0.05；第2三半期 0.63 ± 0.46, P < 0.05；第3三半期 0.24 ± 0.17, P < 0.01）。胞状奇胎と正常妊娠の比には有意差はなかった。これらの所見と、30kDa蛋白が循環から速やかに消失することから、本蛋白は宿主の免疫反応を局所的に抑制することで栄養膜細胞の増殖や宿主への浸潤に関与していると考えられる。絨毛癌で尿中30kDa蛋白が増加するのは、栄養膜細胞の悪性転化により急速な浸潤が起こるためかもしれない。
